columns.name: TenantId
columns.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID

columns.name: Id
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Date and time when the GenAI content was captured

columns.name: TraceId
columns.description: The identifier of the trace this record belongs to

columns.name: SpanId
columns.description: The identifier of the span this content is associated with

columns.name: ParentSpanId
columns.description: The identifier of the parent of the associated span

columns.name: AgentName
columns.description: The name of the GenAI agent

columns.name: AgentId
columns.description: The unique identifier of the GenAI agent

columns.name: ModelName
columns.description: The name of the GenAI model the request is being made to

columns.name: InputMessages
columns.description: The chat history provided to the model as an input

columns.name: OutputMessages
columns.description: Messages returned by the model where each message represents a specific model response

columns.name: SystemInstructions
columns.description: The system message or instructions provided to the GenAI model separately from the chat history

columns.name: ToolDefinitions
columns.description: The list of source system tool definitions available to the GenAI agent or model

columns.name: ToolCallArguments
columns.description: Parameters passed to the tool call

columns.name: ToolCallResult
columns.description: The result returned by the tool call, if any and if execution was successful

columns.name: EvaluationExplanation
columns.description: The explanation or reasoning provided by an evaluation of the GenAI interaction

columns.name: ServiceNamespace
columns.description: A namespace for ServiceName, from the 'service.namespace' resource attribute

columns.name: ServiceName
columns.description: Logical name of the service, from the 'service.name' resource attribute

columns.name: ServiceInstanceId
columns.description: A unique identifier for the instance of the service

columns.name: RoleName
columns.description: A simplified service identifier combining ServiceNamespace and ServiceName

columns.name: Attributes
columns.description: A property bag of additional key-value pairs associated with this record

columns.name: SourceSystem
columns.description: The type of agent the event was collected by

columns.name: Type
columns.description: The name of the table

columns.name: _ResourceId
columns.description: A unique identifier for the resource that the record is associated with
